tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Organization should have a provident fund registration
Attach the turnover certificate by CA( 2021-22 TO 2025-26)
Organization should have a employment state insurance registration
Organization should have a professional Tax Registration
Organization should have a service tax Registration/GST Registration
The Contractor has to pay the minimum wages as per bid document to the employees & the service charge shall be quoted separately as per Bid Document
Executive Engineer has the right to reject the tender at any time without assigning any reasons
ESI & PF Remittance Challans as per bid document
Any other documents as mentioned in Bid Document
Only Service Charge as per the bid document shall be claimed in eproc in percentage. Any other inappropriate percentage claimed will be rejected
